data.name: Nusayr
data.gender_notes: Nusayr is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘ansa’ which means 'helper', 'supporter', or 'aid'. This name is mentioned in the Quran and hadiths, describing Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) as a helper and supporter for his father, Jacob. The name Nusayr carries the meaning “Helper, supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nusayr usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes support and assistance in the path of righteousness.
data.etymology: Nusayr belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper, supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nusayr total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: نُسَير
in_arabic.meaning: النَسيرُ: المُدَّفَعُ، المُتَسَلَّصُ، المَنزِلُ على القَنا
in_arabic.long_meaning: النَسيرُ: المُدَّفَعُ، المُتَسَلَّصُ، المَنزِلُ على القَنا، والقَنا: الحَيُّ المَذَّكَرُ، النَسيرُ اسمٌ لِلبَياضِ، ويُعتَبَرُ من أَفضلِ أسماءِ اللَهِ، وَقد ذُكِرَ في القرآنِ الكريمِ، وَيَعودُ في كِساءِ النبيِّ صَلَواتُ اللَهِ عليهِ، وَبِالنَسيرِ تُعرَفُ المَدينةُ النَبَوِيَّةُ، فَكَأَنَّمَا كانَ النَسيرُ نِطَعًا لِلَّهِ، وَهوَ مِن أُمورِ المَعالي، وَالعَلياء، وَالنَسيرُ مِن أَسماءِ اللَهِ العَظيمِ، وَهوَ مَنزِلٌ عَلى القَنا

in_urdu.name: نُسَیر
in_urdu.meaning: نَسیر: مدفوع، متسلس، منزل على قنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: نَسیر: مدفوع، متسلس، منزل على قنا، قنا: حی مذکر، نَسیر اسمabayض، عُتبَر مَنزِلہ اچھے اسماء اللہ سے، قران مجید میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، نبی صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے کساء میں بھی نَسیر ہے، مدینہ نبیہ میں بھی نَسیر کے نام سے جانا جاتا ہے، جیسے کہ نَسیر اللہ کا نِطع ہے، یہ عظیم معاملوں اور عظیم لوگوں کا نام ہے، نَسیر اللہ عظیم کا مُنزل ہے

Nusayr is a name that is rich in meaning and is considered one of the most beautiful names of Allah. It is a name that is worthy of mention and is a symbol of goodness and prosperity.

During this period, many people converted to Islam, and the name "Nusayr" was given as a tribute to their new Islamic faith. It became a symbol of Islamic identity and pride, especially in the Maghreb region.

It emphasizes the importance of being a helper and supporter to fellow believers, embodying the essence of Muslim brotherhood and sisterhood. Moreover, the name brings to mind the story of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) and his unwavering support for his father, showcasing the role of patience, love, and dedication in Islamic teachings. Ultimately, "Nusayr" serves as a reflection of the strength and unity derived from the bond of faith and shared spiritual journey with others.
